basic_info.description: Discover this incredible opportunity, a trophy triplex in San Francisco's Nob Hill neighborhood. This enormous 3-unit Edwardian building exudes charm and character while providing an ideal investment or 1031 opportunity. Fully-occupied with a fantastic rent roll over $13,500/month, this building has both tremendous upside, with an already impressive monthly return. Step inside these extra-large full-floor flats to find beautiful hardwood floors throughout that add to the timeless charm of this well-maintained property. The building includes three large 3/4 bedroom, 1.5 bath full-floor units. Each unit featuring its own unique period details, ample natural light, and timeless San Francisco charm. There is also a full basement ready for development into additional units, ADUs, or immediate ample storage use. With a 99 Walk Score, and 100 Bike Score, California St. is perfectly walkable to everything San Francisco has to offer! Polk St. hot spots, Trader Joes, Grace Cathedral, The Masonic music venue, and all the amazing restaurants, bars, and nightlife just to name a few. Easy commute to downtown via walking, biking, or the classic SF Cable Cars.
